name: Morana Online
storyline:
In the world of the MMORPG Morana Online, players find themselves in a kingdom plunged into eternal winter. The earth is under the influence of a mysterious and feared character known to all under the name Morana.

For centuries, the kingdom of Dalmarok has been locked in an icy grip. Its inhabitants struggle to survive amid the perpetual freeze. Players, adventurers drawn to this unforgiving land, seek to confront Morana's disciples and put an end to the relentless cold.

As they explore the icy wilderness, they discover tales of the villagers and their tragic stories. According to legend, Morana had been an ice mage gifted in her human life, but her powers had inadvertently brought disaster to her village. Stricken with guilt and remorse, she had transformed into an icy entity, seeking solitude and redemption.
summary:
A 3D browser-based fantasy MMORPG with dynamic loot and competitive rankings.

Morana Online is a 3D medieval fantasy MMORPG where players explore immersive levels filled with monsters, NPCs, and interactive objects. As they progress, players can battle enemies, complete quests, and collect a wide variety of loot — from common gear to ultra-rare treasures.

Each item collected contributes to the player’s main ranking score, making exploration, combat, and smart gear management essential for rising to the top. With multiple rarity tiers, a deep inventory system, and real-time interaction with other players, Morana Online delivers a rich multiplayer experience — right in your browser, no installation required.
